# Ubhona Builder Kit

This folder collects the repo-scoped skills, MCPs, and high-signal build helpers used to build and debug Ubhona.

Contents:

- [SKILLS.md](./SKILLS.md): repo skills and when to use them
- [MCPS.md](./MCPS.md): active MCP servers and what they are useful for
- [COMMANDS.md](./COMMANDS.md): build, test, backend, and validation commands
- [WORKFLOW.md](./WORKFLOW.md): recommended engineering flow for Ubhona work

Primary repo locations referenced by this kit:

- Repo operating instructions: [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)
- Repo skills directory: [.agents/skills](../../.agents/skills)
- Frontend scripts: [package.json](../../package.json)
- Backend scripts: [backend/package.json](../../backend/package.json)

This kit is documentation-only. It does not replace the actual skill files under `.agents/skills`.
